title: Architecture Contract Specification
description: Machine-readable contract defining architectural layers, allowed/forbidden imports, and code integrity rules for agentic development.

project.description: The name or identifier of the project

assurance_level.description: Target Assurance Level from the framework

layers.description: Mapping of layer names to their respective constraints

path.description: Directory or file glob pattern for files in this layer

allowed_imports.description: Explicit whitelist of top-level modules allowed to be imported in this layer

forbidden_imports.description: Blacklist of modules strictly prohibited from being imported in this layer

allow_wildcard_imports.description: Whether 'from module import *' is permitted in this layer

max_file_lines.description: Maximum allowed lines of code per file in this layer
